name: The Line That Floats

levels.entry: Iron rail running out over the strait. Nothing under it and no legs down to the water.
The rail is bedded on the same black ore, in short lengths, laid end to end.
The carriage does not touch the rail. There is a hand's width of nothing between them the whole way over.
Bolt holes along the underside of the rail, and no bolts, and no rust in the holes. It was built to be taken up again.
Somebody worked out that the ore that makes the islands impossible makes the crossing cheap, and then built a road they could unbuild. I would like to know what they were expecting.

notes: Aravali. Deliberately unresolved at the last rung -- the diary describes exactly and refuses to guess, which is the discipline this game is about.
